outgoing.name: Italy
outgoing.excerpt: The Autobianchi Primula was a small car ( supermini) from the Italian automaker, Autobianchi (a subsidiary of the Fiat group), built from 1964 to 1970.

outgoing.name: Mini
outgoing.excerpt: First popularized by the legendary Mini, it also found its way to other, bigger models, starting with BMC's own Austin/Morris 1100.
